title.purpose: The page title in the header, one per page.

body.purpose: Running text; prose at 1.5 line-height, at most 65ch.

ledger.purpose: Table rows, controls, the identity strip — the console's working density.

label.purpose: Column headers, definition terms, the KIND half of a label strip; beside data, never above a heading.

identifier.purpose: Names, namespaces, paths and users — what an operator copies.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Float: the identity panel and the disabled-reason tooltip.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focusable element; inset on rail links.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing; exponential ease-out from a visible default.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a surface; accent fill, on-accent ink.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b8bec7); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-surface, #fff); color: var(--fg, #1a1d21); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary { border-color: var(--accent, #4f55d2); background: var(--accent, #4f55d2); color: var(--fg-on-accent, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #4f55d2) 88%, var(--fg, #1a1d21)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg-surface, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent, #4f55d2); }

components.name: Button
components.description: The default control: surface fill, strong hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b8bec7); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-surface, #fff); color: var(--fg, #1a1d21); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, rgba(26,29,33,0.05)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg-surface, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent, #4f55d2); }

components.name: Disabled Button With Reason
components.description: An action the user may not perform: visible, disabled, and explained on hover and focus.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-reason" type="button" aria-disabled="true" data-reason="Delete snapshots is not permitted for alice in namespace prod. Ask a cluster admin to bind kopiur-ui-editor to your user or group.">Delete snapshot</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b8bec7); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-surface, #fff); color: var(--fg, #1a1d21); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-reason { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-reason::after { content: attr(data-reason); position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 6px); left: 0; width: max-content; max-width: 28rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d5d9df); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-surface, #fff); color: var(--fg, #1a1d21); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(26,29,33,0.18); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; white-space: normal; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); transition: opacity 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-reason:hover::after, .ds-btn-reason:focus-visible::after { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

components.name: Health Lamp
components.description: A health state as colour, icon and word together; never colour alone.
components.html: Failed
components.css: .ds-health { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35em; padding: 0.1em 0.5em 0.1em 0.4em; border-radius: 3px; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--health-unknown-fg, #4f5761); background: var(--health-unknown-bg, #e7e9ed); } .ds-health[data-health="failed"] { color: var(--health-failed-fg, #a6320b); background: var(--health-failed-bg, #fbe3d9); } .ds-health[data-health="healthy"] { color: var(--health-healthy-fg, #0b6e4f); background: var(--health-healthy-bg, #ddf3ea); } .ds-health[data-health="degraded"] { color: var(--health-degraded-fg, #7a4e00); background: var(--health-degraded-bg, #fbefd3); } .ds-health[data-health="pending"] { color: var(--health-pending-fg, #0b5c8f); background: var(--health-pending-bg, #dceef8); }

components.name: Label Strip
components.description: An object's identity: KIND in label caps beside its name in monospace.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-strip-kind { font: 500 0.6875rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-faint, #636c78); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-strip-name { font: 400 0.8125rem/1.35 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--fg, #1a1d21); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Icon + label rows on the slate rail; the current row carries the one accent bar.
components.html: OverviewSnapshotsPolicies
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 232px; padding: 0.5rem 0; background: var(--bg-rail, #e9ebef); border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #d5d9df); } .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 2.125rem; padding: 0 1rem; color: var(--fg-muted, #4f5761); font: 500 0.8125rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, rgba(26,29,33,0.05)); color: var(--fg, #1a1d21); } .ds-nav[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--fg, #1a1d21); background: var(--bg-active, rgba(26,29,33,0.09)); } .ds-nav[aria-current="page"]::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4px auto 4px 0; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: var(--accent, #4f55d2); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--bg-surface, #fff), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--accent, #4f55d2); }

components.css: .ds-problem { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr); gap: 0.5rem 0.75rem; align-items: start; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--health-failed-fg, #a6320b); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--health-failed-bg, #fbe3d9); color: var(--fg, #1a1d21); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-problem-icon { color: var(--health-failed-fg, #a6320b); margin-top: 0.1em; } .ds-problem-body { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-problem-what { font-weight: 600; } .ds-problem-why { color: var(--fg-muted, #4f5761); } .ds-problem-fix { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: baseline; margin-top: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bg-surface, #fff); } .ds-problem-fix-label { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent, #4f55d2); } .ds-problem-meta { font: 400 0.6875rem/1.35 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: var(--fg-faint, #636c78); }

components.name: Skeleton Ledger
components.description: Loading: the silhouette of the rows to come, never a spinner.
components.css: .ds-skel { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; } .ds-skel-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 2fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; } .ds-skel-row span { display: block; height: 0.9em; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--skeleton-base, #e9ebef) 0%, var(--skeleton-sheen, #f6f7f9) 45%, var(--skeleton-base, #e9ebef) 90%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-sheen 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-sheen { from { background-position: 120% 0; } to { background-position: -80% 0; } }

narrative.overview:
kopiur-ui is read the way a tape librarian reads the vault: rows of labelled media, each with a kind, a name and a lettered retention ring, on an anodised slate chassis that says nothing when all is well. It is an Operate surface — dense, calm, legible at a glance — opened many times a day and sometimes at 3am, so both lights are first-class and neither is a default: the daylit vault and the 3am vault are the same console under different lamps.

Every colour is declared once with light-dark() in src/styles.css; the page follows the OS until the user overrides it through data-theme on <html>, which color-scheme turns into the other set of values. Health is never a hue alone: six lamps, each an icon and a word on a tinted field, and the accent is reserved by law for selection, the current marker and the primary action. Where healthy is quiet, a failure is loud and specific — what happened, why, and the fix on its own plate.
keyCharacteristics: Slate neutrals, cool in both lights; one indigo accent; six Okabe–Ito-derived health lamps
One system sans for everything; monospace only for identifiers and paths; tabular numerals throughout
1px hairlines and 6px chamfers; one level of enclosure, never a card inside a card
Label strips (small-caps KIND + mono name) and lettered lamps as the two recurring marks
Skeleton loading, teaching empty states, and what / why / fix errors with the fix set apart

rules.name: The Lettered Lamp Rule
rules.body: A health colour never appears without its icon and its word. HealthBadge is the only way to render one.

rules.name: The Accent By Law Rule
rules.body: Indigo marks selection, the current item, focus and the primary action. It is never a health colour, never a border for emphasis, never a background wash.

rules.name: The One Declaration Rule
rules.body: Every colour is written once as light-dark(light, dark). There is no dark block to keep in sync.

rules.name: The Mono For Identifiers Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for what gets copied — names, paths, users — never a costume for "technical".

rules.name: The Rank By Weight Rule
rules.body: Five sizes only. Rank inside a row is carried by weight, case and colour, not by another size.

rules.name: The Hairlines Only Rule
rules.body: Regions are divided by 1px hairlines, never by shadow or by a second box. A card inside a card is always wrong.

dos: Do render every health value through HealthBadge — icon and word, never a coloured dot.
Do declare a new colour once, as light-dark(light, dark), and check both pairs clear 4.5:1.
Do set identifiers in monospace and numbers in tabular figures.
Do disable an action the user may not perform and say why (ActionButton.disabledReason from capabilityReason).
Do render a problem's what, why and fix from the server's own text, fix set apart.
donts: Don't put a label, kicker or eyebrow above a heading; label caps sit beside data, in table heads and definition terms only.
Don't use the accent for a health state, a border for emphasis, or a background wash.
Don't nest a panel in a panel or divide regions with shadows; use a hairline.
Don't use a spinner; loading is a skeleton of the rows to come.
Don't let an unknown or unrecognised value fall through to the healthy lamp.
